module_summary: Platform layer of the main RiptOPL ELF. ioman.cpp is the single IO worker thread with its request queue (IoQueue), the LOG/ioPrintf sink and ioBlockOps drain; hdd.cpp wraps the APA/PFS devctls (status, space, DMA mode, idle, flush, sector reads) and enumerates HDL games and POPS/Ember partitions; elfldr_noreset.cpp copies the embedded elfldr child to 0x84000 and ExecPS2s into it for every app/POPSTARTER/Ember/Neutrino handoff; httpclient.cpp and nbns.cpp are EE SIF RPC clients for the httpclient and nbns IRX; httpcatalog.cpp parses games.csv (also built on the host by tools/pc/http/tests); ioprp.cpp builds the patched IOPRP image (upstream OPL); diaglog.cpp is the RAM ring behind DIAG.TXT plus the diag-build boot trace; launchdiag.cpp is a compiled-out UDPBD launch triage marker set; debug.cpp loads the UDP/PPC TTY debug modules in debug configurations; md5.c is the upstream Aladdin MD5 (RA edition only); new.cpp replaces the throwing operator new/delete; ps2cnf.cpp reads BOOT2 from SYSTEM.CNF; ratls.h is the HTTPS (mbedTLS) API used by the RA and updater overlays.

reusable_helpers.name: hddReadSectors
reusable_helpers.what: reads raw APA sectors through the HDIOC_READSECTOR devctl

reusable_helpers.name: hddGetPartitionInfo
reusable_helpers.what: reads an APA header and returns the main and sub-partition extents

reusable_helpers.name: ioPutRequest
reusable_helpers.what: queues work for the IO worker thread (ioPutRequestUnlessWaiting dedupes)

reusable_helpers.name: ioBlockOpsTimed
reusable_helpers.what: drains the IO queue with an optional tick bound and blocks new requests

reusable_helpers.name: diagLog
reusable_helpers.what: time-stamped printf into a 16 KB RAM ring, interrupt-safe

reusable_helpers.name: sysLoadELFApp
reusable_helpers.what: ELF handoff through the embedded elfldr child with argv budget check and open probe

reusable_helpers.name: httpCatalogSkipBlankOrComment
reusable_helpers.what: skips leading blanks and returns NULL for blank or #-comment lines

reusable_helpers.name: patch_IOPRP_image
reusable_helpers.what: copies an IOPRP romdir image replacing CDVDMAN/CDVDFSV/EESYNC, 16-byte aligned

reusable_helpers.name: ps2cnfGetBootFile
reusable_helpers.what: reads the BOOT2 entry from a SYSTEM.CNF file

reusable_helpers.name: nbnsFindName
reusable_helpers.what: NetBIOS name lookup over SIF RPC to nbns.irx

findings.title: Legacy HTTP SEND_GET_REQ path (EE HttpSendGetRequest + IOP HttpGetResponse/HttpSendGetRequest) has no caller since the compatibility updater is gone
findings.problem: No EE code calls HttpSendGetRequest or HttpStreamEnd (grep: only their definitions in httpclient.cpp and host test_stream.c); opl.map drops both (400 + 8 bytes). The IOP SEND_GET_REQ case, its 512-byte DmaBuffer and the IOP HttpSendGetRequest with its private helpers GetData, HttpParseEntityLine, HttpGetResponse and GetDayInWeek therefore serve only a host test. The 'compatibility updater' named in httpclient.h:36,55 no longer exists (only guiGameCompatUpdater, a dialog callback). All live HTTP goes through STREAM_BEGIN/READ.
findings.fix: Delete the EE HttpSendGetRequest and HttpStreamEnd wrappers, the IOP SEND_GET_REQ case and DmaBuffer, IOP HttpSendGetRequest, HttpGetResponse, HttpParseEntityLine, GetData, GetDayInWeek and the work-buffer statics, the HttpClientSendGetArgs/Result structs, the mtime doc, prototype, I_ macro and stale 'compatibility updater' comments, and test 20 in test_stream.c. Remove the enum value on both sides together (EE and IRX are built as one) and keep the export ordinals by replacing the export line with _retonly or renumbering the I_ macros.
findings.benefit: ~310 source lines removed. EE: no ELF change (already gc'd, MEASURED raw/riptopl-discarded-firstparty.txt). IOP: httpclient.irx (10,917 bytes, MEASURED raw/irx-modules.tsv) is linked without --gc-sections, so roughly 2-3 KB of .text plus 512 B .bss leaves the embedded IRX (INFERRED from function sizes).
findings.evidence: grep -rn HttpSendGetRequest|HttpStreamEnd over the repo (excluding docs): EE definitions httpclient.cpp:61,157; IOP httpclient.c:343, main.c:50, exports.tab:9, httpclient.h:20,145, httpstream.inc:105 (IOP HttpStreamEnd, used by main.c:41 and device-http.c:53, keep); host test test_stream.c:302,307; no src/ caller. HTTP_CLIENT_CMD_SEND_GET_REQ appears only in httpclient.h:48, main.c:44, httpclient.cpp:86. Within httpclient.c, HttpGetResponse is used at 377,388 (both inside SendGet), HttpParseEntityLine at 195 (inside HttpGetResponse), GetData at 189,234 (inside HttpGetResponse), GetDayInWeek at 371. raw/riptopl-discarded-firstparty.txt lists .text._Z18HttpSendGetRequest... 400 bytes and .text._Z13HttpStreamEndv 8 bytes. grep compat updater: only guiGameCompatUpdater (src/ui/guigame.cpp:1715), a dialog callback.

findings.title: LAUNCH_DIAG UDPBD triage markers are hard-wired off (#define LAUNCH_DIAG 0) yet keep ~250 lines across 13 files
findings.problem: launchdiag.h:41 is a plain #define LAUNCH_DIAG 0 (no build can override it; commit be17a194 'LAUNCH_DIAG off for merge'), so launchdiag.cpp compiles to nothing, gLaunchDiag is the constant 0 and every marker, hold and refusal call is a no-op stub. The machinery is a finished one-off triage build for a single UDPBD hang (#755) that now costs a source file, a 92-line header, call sites in 6 files, a child-side copy in elfldr/loader.c and stale includes in 9 files (menuitems, appscan, sysvmc, system, sysdisc, settingsio, lwnbdctl, autolaunch use no launchDiag symbol).
findings.fix: Delete src/platform/launchdiag.cpp (and its ps2.yaml:641 source entry), include/launchdiag.h, every launchDiag*/gLaunchDiag call and include, the diag parameter of probeTarget/sysLoadELFCommon, the LAUNCHDIAG_* block in elfldr/loader.c, and the LAUNCH_DIAG checks in test_handoff_probe.py and the stubs in test_neutrino_argv_budget.py. Keep the LOG lines. Git history keeps the triage build.
findings.benefit: ~250 source lines removed (86 + 92 + ~70 call sites/includes); no ELF change because LAUNCH_DIAG 0 already compiles it all out (INFERRED from the #if at launchdiag.cpp:5 and the inline stubs at launchdiag.h:72-88).
findings.evidence: grep -rn LAUNCH_DIAG|gLaunchDiag|launchDiag over the repo: definitions in launchdiag.h/.cpp; calls only in elfldr_noreset.cpp, opl.cpp, bdmlaunch.cpp, sysneutrino.cpp; elfldr/loader.c:151 '#if LAUNCH_DIAG'; the other 8 listed files only #include it. No ps2.yaml/tools define LAUNCH_DIAG (it is #define'd, not #ifndef). git log -S'#define LAUNCH_DIAG 1': 34ed855b added it, be17a194 turned it off. Tests that reference it: .github/scripts/test_handoff_probe.py:78-91, test_neutrino_argv_budget.py:66,76-77.

findings.title: __DECI2_DEBUG debug path is never built (no ps2build configuration defines it), plus always-true _DTL_T10000 guards in debug.cpp
findings.problem: __DECI2_DEBUG is set only by the legacy Makefile (DECI2_DEBUG ?= 0, Makefile:84,339-343) and tools/syntax_sweep.py; tools/build_configuration.py never adds it, and no ps2.yaml target embeds drvtif/tifinet or deci2.img, so every DECI2 branch is dead and the five modules/debug blobs (92,197 bytes) are referenced only by the Makefile. In debug.cpp the _DTL_T10000 guards are also always true: debug.cpp is added only by the debug configurations (build_configuration.py:79-83) and configurations are exclusive, so none of them has _DTL_T10000 (only 'dtl', :41-43).
findings.fix: Delete every #ifdef __DECI2_DEBUG block (keeping the #else/#elif branch where there is one), the drvtif/tifinet IMPORT_BIN2C lines, the DECI2 set in syntax_sweep.py and the modules/debug DECI2 blobs; in debug.cpp drop the #ifndef _DTL_T10000 wrappers and turn the TTY_UDP || __DECI2_DEBUG test into #ifdef TTY_UDP.
findings.benefit: ~130 source lines and 92,197 bytes of committed binaries (MEASURED inventory/RiptOPL.tsv) removed; no shipped-ELF change since no build compiles these branches (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: grep -rn __DECI2_DEBUG|DECI2_DEBUG|drvtif|tifinet|deci2 over src include ee_core tools ps2.yaml Makefile .github: defines only in Makefile:340 and ee_core/Makefile:44 (legacy) and tools/syntax_sweep.py:23; build_configuration.py:79-117 adds __DEBUG, TTY_UDP/TTY_PPC_UART, never __DECI2_DEBUG; no ps2.yaml embed of drvtif/tifinet/deci2. Block extents from an #if/#endif matcher over each file. _DTL_T10000 only at build_configuration.py:43 under configuration=='dtl'; debug.cpp added at :83 under 'debug' in configuration. Blob sizes: deci2.img 73625, drvtif*.irx 2x5985, tifinet*.irx 2x3301.

findings.title: ioGetPendingRequestCount/IoQueue::pendingCount and IoQueue::total/totalByType_ are never used
findings.problem: ioGetPendingRequestCount (and the IoQueue::pendingCount it wraps) has no caller; comments at ioman.cpp:30 and artload.cpp:151 record that its one user was removed because it froze the menu. IoQueue::total() has no caller and totalByType_ is only incremented (ioman.cpp:282); only ioGetPending (per-type pending) feeds the HUD. ioman.h:48-52 still advertises a 'running total'.
findings.fix: Delete ioGetPendingRequestCount, IoQueue::pendingCount, IoQueue::total, totalByType_ and its increment, their declarations, and the 'running total' wording in ioman.h; drop the pendingCount half of test_io_menu_lifetime.py.
findings.benefit: ~32 source lines; 232 bytes of .text already dropped by --gc-sections (MEASURED raw/riptopl-discarded-firstparty.txt: 96+96+40), so ELF change is only the 16-byte totalByType_ array (INFERRED: IO_REQ_TYPE_COUNT 4 x 4 bytes).
findings.evidence: grep -rn 'ioGetPendingRequestCount|pendingCount\(|\.total\(|totalByType_' over the repo: definitions ioman.cpp:342,432,55; declarations ioman.h:43, ioqueue.h:30,33,85; increment ioman.cpp:282; mentions only in comments (ioman.cpp:30, artload.cpp:151) and .github/scripts/test_io_menu_lifetime.py (extracts the function text). ioGetPending is used by guioverlay.cpp:216 and textures.cpp:931-932. opl.h:64 IO_REQ_TYPE_COUNT 4.

findings.title: ioman: 24-line banner about a removed constant, orphaned doc comment, unused IO_ERR_UNKNOWN_REQUEST_TYPE
findings.problem: ioman.cpp:16-39 narrates why a MAX_IO_REQUESTS constant that no longer exists was removed and names gProcSemaId and texcache.c, which are not in the code any more (the semaphore is procSema_). ioman.h:38-40 documents a 'removes all requests of a given type' function that has no prototype or definition. IO_ERR_UNKNOWN_REQUEST_TYPE has no user. IoQueue::process checks req for NULL although its only caller passes head_ after testing it, and its 'invalidate the request' comment describes nothing.
findings.fix: Delete the banner (a one-line 'no queue cap by design' note is enough), the orphaned doc comment, the unused macro, the NULL check and the stale comment.
findings.benefit: ~31 lines removed, almost all comments; no ELF change (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: grep -rn IO_ERR_UNKNOWN_REQUEST_TYPE: only ioman.h:8. grep -rn gProcSemaId|MAX_IO_REQUESTS over src include: only the ioman.cpp banner. grep for a remove-requests function (ioRemoveRequests) over src include: none; ioman.h:38-40 is followed directly by ioGetPendingRequestCount's comment. process() is called only from workerLoop ioman.cpp:142 inside while (head_).

findings.title: elfldr_noreset: two forwarding wrappers and a partition parameter that is ignored
findings.problem: sysLoadELF (static) only forwards to sysLoadELFCommon with cleanupHdd 0, and is called only by sysLoadELFKeepIOP; sysLoadELFApp only forwards to sysLoadELFCommon. The partition argument is discarded with (void)partition 'for API compatibility', yet all six callers are in this repo and three pass "".
findings.fix: Delete sysLoadELF; have sysLoadELFKeepIOP call sysLoadELFCommon(..., 0, 0) directly (or make sysLoadELFApp the implementation). Drop the partition parameter from both public functions and their six call sites, and from the signature mocks in test_app_launch_args.py and test_neutrino_argv_budget.py.
findings.benefit: ~8 lines and one call layer removed; no measurable ELF change (static wrapper is inlined, INFERRED).
findings.evidence: grep -rn 'sysLoadELFCommon|sysLoadELF\(' : definition :150, callers :251,:256, sysLoadELF only called at :261; test_handoff_probe.py:86 looks for 'static int sysLoadELFCommon(' so keep that name. grep -rn sysLoadELFApp|sysLoadELFKeepIOP (code): appsupport.cpp:1074,1257,1296; system.cpp:1259,1301; sysneutrino.cpp:1430; system.h:119-120; partition is never read in sysLoadELFCommon (only :165 (void)partition).

findings.title: ioprp.cpp: patch_CDVDFSV and patch_EESYNC duplicate patch_CDVDMAN; Align_offsets NULL checks never fire
findings.problem: patch_CDVDMAN(image, entry, src, size) is already the generic memcpy-plus-size; patch_CDVDFSV and patch_EESYNC are the same two lines with a fixed blob. Align_offsets is called once (line 60) with &offset_in and &offset_out, so its two NULL tests are always true. Upstream OPL code.
findings.fix: Delete patch_CDVDFSV and patch_EESYNC and their prototypes and call patch_CDVDMAN with cdvdfsv_irx/size_cdvdfsv_irx and eesync_irx/size_eesync_irx; drop the NULL checks (or inline the two align steps into the loop).
findings.benefit: ~22 lines removed; no ELF change, the static inline helpers already compile to the same code (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Read ioprp.cpp fully: patch_* used only at :47-51, Align_offsets only at :60 with address-of arguments. File is upstream Open PS2 Loader IOPRP patching code.

findings.title: httpcatalog.cpp hand-rolls case-insensitive compares that strcasecmp already does
findings.problem: httpEndsWithNoCase lower-cases both strings by hand in a 19-line loop, and the CD/DVD media token test spells out each letter in both cases; strcasecmp (used elsewhere in src, e.g. supportbase.cpp:101) does both in one call and exists on newlib and on the host where tools/pc/http/tests builds this file.
findings.fix: Make httpEndsWithNoCase 'ls > lx && strcasecmp(s + ls - lx, suffix) == 0' and the media test strcasecmp(m, "CD") / strcasecmp(m, "DVD"); include <strings.h>.
findings.benefit: ~14 lines removed; a few dozen bytes of .text (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Read httpcatalog.cpp fully; strcasecmp already used in src/sources/supportbase.cpp:101, src/app/opl.cpp, src/core/lang.cpp. The host fixture diff (tools/pc/http/tests/compare_catalog.py) would confirm unchanged behaviour.

findings.title: nbns.h: IOP import macros and NBNS_RPC_ID_COUNT are unused
findings.problem: nbnsman_IMPORTS_start/end and I_nbnsFindName appear only in nbns.h (no imports.lst or IRX imports nbnsman; the menu reaches nbns over RPC), and NBNS_RPC_ID_COUNT is never read.
findings.fix: Delete the #ifdef _IOP import block and NBNS_RPC_ID_COUNT.
findings.benefit: 7 lines removed; no binary change (INFERRED, macros only).
findings.evidence: grep -rn 'nbnsman|I_nbnsFindName|NBNS_RPC_ID_COUNT' over the whole repo (all file types, excluding .git and docs): only nbns.h:5,21,22,24, the export table modules/network/nbns/exports.tab:2 and main.c:20,49,62,74 (_exp_nbnsman registration, kept). No imports.lst names nbnsman.

findings.title: ps2cnf CNFGetKey: unreachable EOF branch, and no terminator for a 64-character BOOT2 path
findings.problem: The loop condition already stops at '\0', so the '*line == '\0'' branch at 62-64 can never run (its own comment admits it duplicates the earlier check). When the token fills all CNF_PATH_LEN_MAX (64) bytes the loop exits without writing a terminator, and GetStartupExecName then scans its 64-byte ps2disc_boot for ':' or '\0' past the end. Only a malformed SYSTEM.CNF with a 64+ char BOOT2 value triggers it.
findings.fix: Loop to CNF_PATH_LEN_MAX - 1, delete the unreachable branch, and always write the terminator after the loop.
findings.benefit: 3 lines removed and an out-of-bounds read on a malformed disc closed (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Read ps2cnf.cpp:42-68 and the only caller supportbase.cpp:114-130 (grep ps2cnfGetBootFile: supportbase.cpp:120 only); ps2disc_boot is char[CNF_PATH_LEN_MAX] = "" (zero-filled), so only the 64-byte case lacks a NUL.
